resources.string: Turn boost on, plug into the car, play music. Drag until it sounds right.
Boost on — waiting to lock onto Spotify
Only when USB / car is connected
Turn on when I plug into the car
Volume. If it crackles, drag down. Pause and press play if it has not locked on — or tap Lock onto Spotify.
Boosting the phone speaker. If it sounds harsh, turn Boost level down — the car can take more than the speaker.
Boost on — waiting for USB / car
Boost is on, but “Only when USB / car is connected” is enabled, so it will not change the phone speaker. Turn that switch off to test at home.
Spotify is playing, but boost is not attached yet. Tap Lock onto Spotify, or pause then press play.
Play Spotify (or YouTube Music), then tap Lock onto Spotify.
Boost is off. Tap Turn on when you want it.
USB / Android Auto — boost is on.
Bluetooth — boost is on if this is the car.
On the phone speaker — plug into the car, or turn off “Only in the car / USB”.
Update %1$s is ready. Tap again to install.
Could not check or download. Try again on Wi‑Fi.
Allow USB Boost to install updates, then tap Check for update again.
Add the USB Boost tile in Quick Settings for a one-tap toggle.
